sources.title: The Scottish Parliament — 400th Anniversary of Charles I's Accession (S6M-16963)
sources.citation_text: The Scottish Parliament motion S6M-16963 expressly lists Charles I's Irish as well as English and Scottish royal crowns on the 1625 accession; it records his execution in January 1649. The Irish crown claim remains historically separate from effective administration of Irish territories amid the 1641 rebellion and subsequent wars. This is a legislative motion's historical summary, not an independent Irish office-appointment charter.
